schema.text: How adequate is the cycling infrastructure (cycle lanes, paths, and signage) on your typical route?

options.text: Very inadequate — little or no cycling infrastructure exists
Inadequate — some provision exists but it is fragmented or poorly designed
Partially adequate — infrastructure covers part of my route
Mostly adequate — infrastructure is reasonably good along most of my route
Very adequate — cycling infrastructure is excellent throughout my route

en.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: How adequate is the cycling infrastructure (cycle lanes, paths, and signage) on your typical route?
en.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Very inadequate — little or no cycling infrastructure exists

en.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Partially adequate — infrastructure covers part of my route

en.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Very adequate — cycling infrastructure is excellent throughout my route

it.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Quanto è adeguata l’infrastruttura ciclabile, comprese piste, percorsi e segnaletica, lungo il tuo tragitto abituale?
it.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Del tutto inadeguata — l’infrastruttura ciclabile è scarsa o assente
it.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Inadeguata — esistono alcune infrastrutture, ma sono frammentate o mal progettate
it.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Parzialmente adeguata — l’infrastruttura copre solo una parte del mio percorso
it.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Per lo più adeguata — l’infrastruttura è abbastanza buona lungo gran parte del mio percorso
it.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Molto adeguata — l’infrastruttura ciclabile è eccellente lungo tutto il mio percorso

fr.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Les infrastructures cyclables de votre trajet habituel, comme les pistes, les voies et la signalisation, sont-elles adaptées ?
fr.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Très insuffisantes — il y a peu ou pas d’infrastructures cyclables
fr.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Insuffisantes — certaines infrastructures existent, mais elles sont discontinues ou mal conçues
fr.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Partiellement adaptées — les infrastructures couvrent une partie de mon trajet
fr.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Plutôt adaptées — les infrastructures sont assez bonnes sur la majeure partie de mon trajet
fr.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Très adaptées — les infrastructures cyclables sont excellentes sur tout mon trajet

de.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Wie gut ist die Fahrradinfrastruktur auf Ihrer üblichen Strecke, zum Beispiel Radwege, Fahrstreifen und Beschilderung?
de.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Sehr schlecht — es gibt kaum oder keine Fahrradinfrastruktur
de.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Schlecht — es gibt zwar Infrastruktur, aber sie ist lückenhaft oder schlecht gestaltet
de.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Teilweise gut — die Infrastruktur deckt einen Teil meiner Strecke ab
de.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Meist gut — auf dem größten Teil meiner Strecke ist die Infrastruktur in Ordnung
de.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Sehr gut — auf meiner gesamten Strecke ist die Fahrradinfrastruktur sehr gut

tr.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Tipik güzergâhınızdaki bisiklet altyapısı, örneğin bisiklet yolları, şeritler ve yönlendirme işaretleri, ne kadar yeterli?
tr.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Çok yetersiz — çok az bisiklet altyapısı var veya hiç yok
tr.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Yetersiz — bazı altyapılar var, ancak kesintili veya kötü tasarlanmış
tr.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Kısmen yeterli — altyapı güzergâhımın bir bölümünü kapsıyor
tr.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Büyük ölçüde yeterli — güzergâhımın çoğunda altyapı oldukça iyi
tr.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Çok yeterli — güzergâhım boyunca bisiklet altyapısı çok iyi

fa.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: زیرساخت دوچرخه در مسیر معمول شما، مانند مسیر دوچرخه، خط دوچرخه و تابلوها، چقدر مناسب است؟
fa.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: بسیار نامناسب — زیرساخت دوچرخه بسیار کم است یا وجود ندارد
fa.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: نامناسب — مقداری زیرساخت وجود دارد، اما پیوسته نیست یا طراحی خوبی ندارد
fa.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: تا حدی مناسب — زیرساخت بخشی از مسیر من را پوشش می‌دهد
fa.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: بیشتر مناسب — در بیشتر مسیر من زیرساخت نسبتاً خوب است
fa.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: بسیار مناسب — در تمام مسیر من زیرساخت دوچرخه بسیار خوب است

hu.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Mennyire megfelelő a kerékpáros infrastruktúra a szokásos útvonalán, például a kerékpársávok, kerékpárutak és jelzések?
hu.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Nagyon nem megfelelő — alig van vagy egyáltalán nincs kerékpáros infrastruktúra
hu.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Nem megfelelő — van némi infrastruktúra, de szakaszos vagy rosszul kialakított
hu.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Részben megfelelő — az infrastruktúra az útvonalam egy részét lefedi
hu.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Többnyire megfelelő — az útvonalam nagy részén elég jó az infrastruktúra
hu.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Nagyon megfelelő — az egész útvonalon nagyon jó a kerékpáros infrastruktúra

ar.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: ما مدى ملاءمة البنية التحتية للدراجات على طريقك المعتاد، مثل مسارات الدراجات والحارات والإشارات؟
ar.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: غير ملائمة جدًا — توجد بنية تحتية قليلة جدًا أو لا توجد إطلاقًا
ar.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: غير ملائمة — توجد بعض التجهيزات لكنها متقطعة أو سيئة التصميم
ar.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: ملائمة جزئيًا — تغطي البنية التحتية جزءًا من طريقي
ar.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: ملائمة في معظم الطريق — البنية التحتية جيدة نسبيًا على معظم الطريق
ar.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: ملائمة جدًا — البنية التحتية للدراجات ممتازة على كامل الطريق
